description: Build a limit order: sell sellAmount of sellToken once the market gives at least minReceive of buyToken. Solana (default, Jupiter Trigger): returns an UNSIGNED transaction; LayerHop's fee applies when buyToken is SOL, USDC or USDT. EVM chains with CoW Protocol (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain, Polygon, Avalanche, Gnosis, Linea, Plasma, Ink): returns EIP-712 typed data plus the token approval it needs; sellToken must be an ERC-20. Then the maker's own wallet signs and you call submit_limit_order. Worth at least $5. The LayerHop MCP server holds no private keys and never signs or broadcasts transactions. Confirm the price with the user first.

buyToken.description: Token to buy token: symbol from list_tokens ("USDC", "ETH", "SOL") or the token contract address / SPL mint. Use "native" for the chain's gas coin.

chain.description: Chain of the order (default solana) chain: slug ("base", "solana", "ethereum", "arbitrum"...) or numeric chain id (Solana is 7565164). See list_chains.

expiresInMinutes.description: Cancel automatically after this many minutes. Solana: omit for good-till-cancelled. EVM: default 90 days.

minReceive.description: Minimum HUMAN units of buyToken for the whole sellAmount (the limit price is minReceive / sellAmount), e.g. "0.5" for 0.5 SOL.

sellAmount.description: HUMAN units of sellToken to sell, e.g. "50" for 50 USDC.

sellToken.description: Token to sell token: symbol from list_tokens ("USDC", "ETH", "SOL") or the token contract address / SPL mint. Use "native" for the chain's gas coin.

wallet.description: The maker's wallet (Solana base58 or EVM 0x): signs the order and receives buyToken.

name: create_limit_order
title: Create a limit order (unsigned)
